name: Feedback Principle (Cybernetic Loop)
axiom: People can steer only what reports back what their last action did.
trigger: A long upload shows nothing until it finishes, so people reload and start it again.

checklist.text: Show a state change on every control as soon as it is pressed, not when the request returns.
Keep a progress indicator for any operation that outlasts a second or two.
Report the outcome of a save where the user is looking, not only in a toast that fades.
Measure how long the interface takes to acknowledge an action, and treat silence as a defect.

antiPattern.violation: A file drop zone looks the same while a file is dragged over it, so the user cannot tell whether a drop will be accepted.
antiPattern.remediation: The zone outlines itself, tints its surface, and shows Drop files to upload while a file is over it.

academicOrigin.title: Cybernetics: Or Control and Communication in the Animal and the Machine
